summary: A choice that is on, off, or partly on, and that a form submits when it is on.

indeterminate.description: The choice stands for a group that is partly on. The user's next activation clears it.

required.description: The form cannot be submitted while the choice is off.

value.description: Submitted with the name while the choice is on.

name.description: The name the value is submitted under.

disabled.description: The choice cannot be changed or focused.

root.note: The root holds the author's label text and draws no face and no focus ring of its own.

mark.note: checked: face solid. The full icon size of ui-geometry (a.full, one q more than a.md), its glyph a.md, centred in it with the (S − a)/2 margin of ui-geometry's icon box. Keyboard focus draws the ring round it, following its radius. Drawn as a pseudo-element, so it exists before the component is defined (D57).

events.input: Dispatched when the user toggles the choice.
events.change: Dispatched after input, when the user toggles the choice.

notYet: A public token for the glyph's ink. The token grammar has no segment for a part, so it cannot be told from the label's ink.
